subject: Request: Bridging endorsement to cover post-report window (SOC 2 Type II)
messages:
From: Angela Park <angela.park@evergreen-health.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: compliance@evergreen-health.com
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II - request for bridging endorsement to cover post-report window

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for walking through the SOC 2 package with our audit team last week. We're finalizing Evergreen Health's vendor risk file and need a short bridging endorsement/letter that confirms Redwood's controls coverage from the report end date (2025-12-31) to the current date while you prepare your next period work.

Specifically, our security team asks for:
- A one-page letter summarizing any material changes to in-scope systems or control ownership since 2025-12-31, or an explicit statement that there were none.
- Confirmation of the last external test date and whether any exceptions were identified and remediated.
- A named signatory (title and contact) for the bridging endorsement.

Can you share a draft and an estimated turnaround? We can accept a scanned signature if you prefer DocuSign later.

Thanks,
Angela
Angela Park
Senior Vendor Risk Manager
Evergreen Health

Attachment: evergreen-vendor-questionnaire-2026.xlsx (spreadsheet referenced)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Angela Park <angela.park@evergreen-health.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II - request for bridging endorsement to cover post-report window

Hi Angela —

Appreciate the clear ask. Happy to provide a bridging endorsement. We will:
- Draft a concise bridge letter that states there have been no material changes to in-scope systems or control ownership since 2025-12-31, except as noted (none expected).
- Include the last external test date and our remediation summary.
- Provide a designated signatory: Karthik Iyer, Head of Security & Compliance (karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com).

Plan: Naomi will put together the draft bridge letter and remediation bullet points, I will review, and Karthik will sign. Target to send a draft by end of week (Friday 2026-02-20). If you need an expedited turnaround or a DocuSign link, let us know and we'll prioritize.

Monica
Monica Patel
Sales Operations Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_bridge_letter_placeholder.txt (template reference)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 14:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Draft: bridge endorsement for Evergreen (internal review)

Hi team —

Attached is a one-page draft (redwood_bridge_letter_draft_v1.docx) for Evergreen's vendor file. Key points included:
- Report referenced: SOC 2 Type II for period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (external auditor: Alder & Co).
- Statement: No material changes to in-scope systems or control ownership between 2025-12-31 and 2026-02-20.
- Last external test date: 2025-12-15; exceptions: two low-severity findings remediated as of 2026-01-10 (summary lines included).
- Signatory line suggested: Karthik Iyer, Head of Security & Compliance.

Notes / questions for sign-off:
1) Monica — any sales-related language you want removed?
2) Karthik — confirm you are comfortable signing or if you prefer the CISO (we can cc the CISO).

If all good, I'll export to PDF and start DocuSign routing next week.

Thanks,
Naomi
Security & Compliance Analyst
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_bridge_letter_draft_v1.docx

From: Angela Park <angela.park@evergreen-health.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 11:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft: bridge endorsement for Evergreen (internal review)

Monica / Naomi —

Thanks for the quick turnaround — the draft looks fine to our vendor risk SME. Two tiny asks before we finalize in our file: 
- Can you add a sentence clarifying that the bridging endorsement covers production inference infrastructure and customer data handling processes (so it's explicit about scope)?
- Please include a short contact line for confirmation (phone or direct email for Karthik).

Once you add those, we can accept a scanned signed PDF or a DocuSign-signed document — whichever is easier. If you send by EOD Tuesday (2026-03-03) that's perfect.

Best,
Angela
